note: Builds a DrillAuth over grants, each token joined from its parts with its scope names, whose clock answers each call's at divided by 1000, one instant for every read inside the call; makes the calls in order, require with a token and a scope or _record_failure on a token's bucket; reads each call's outcome from the predecessor's own warning, denied or rate limit tripped, and allowed when it raised and warned nothing; returns the outcomes and the failure map's buckets in order, each failure time multiplied back into whole milliseconds; cases drawn under CPython 3.12.12.
